Diverging bar chart of normalized enrichment scores

Source: R/enrichment_plots.R
plot_enrichment_bars.Rd

Shows the most significant gene sets of one GSEA comparison as bars of their normalized enrichment score (NES), positive to the right and negative to the left of 0, ordered by NES. Each gene set's name is written on the opposite side of 0 from its bar, so that names never cover bars and no axis labels are needed.

Usage

plot_enrichment_bars(
  enrichment,
  comparison = NULL,
  n.up = 10,
  n.down = 10,
  fill = c("direction", "padj"),
  padj.cutoff = 0.05,
  show.ns = FALSE,
  cols = NULL,
  term.replace = NULL,
  wrap.width = NULL,
  cell.height = 0.2,
  panel.width = 4,
  legend.position = "right",
  bg = "transparent",
  ...
)

Arguments

enrichment

Results of standardize_enrichment, or anything it reads, with NES (GSEA results)

comparison

The comparison to draw, when the results hold several. If NULL (default), the first

n.up, n.down

Number of gene sets with positive / negative NES to show, the most significant first, default is 10 each

fill

Bar colours: "direction" (default; one colour for positive and one for negative NES) or "padj" (-log10 adjusted p-value)

padj.cutoff

Adjusted p-value below which a gene set is significant, default is 0.05

show.ns

Whether non-significant gene sets may be shown (faded, and explained in a "Significance" legend), when there are fewer than `n.up` / `n.down` significant ones, default is FALSE

cols

With `fill = "direction"`, the colours of positive and negative NES: a vector named `up` and / or `down`, or two colours (up, down). NULL (default) takes the ends of the "blue-magenta" palette. With `fill = "padj"`, a sequential palette name or colours from low to high, default "seq-purple"

term.replace

Replacements in gene set names, applied after cleaning: a named character vector of regular expressions and their replacements. Default is NULL

wrap.width

Names are wrapped onto lines of at most this many characters. If NULL (default), as wide as half the panel allows

cell.height

Height of a bar's row in inches, default is 0.2

panel.width

Width of the panel in inches, default is 4

legend.position

Position of the legends, default is "right". With `fill = "direction"` the colours need no legend (the side of 0 tells the direction); the significance legend is drawn when non-significant bars are shown

bg

Background colour, default is "transparent"

...

Arguments to standardize_enrichment

Value

A ggplot object; its data are the plotted gene sets

See also

plot_enrichment_dots, standardize_enrichment

Examples

set.seed(1)
fg <- data.frame(pathway = paste0("HALLMARK_SET_", 1:30), pval = runif(30)^4,
                 NES = rnorm(30, sd = 1.5), size = 100)
fg$padj <- p.adjust(fg$pval, "BH")
plot_enrichment_bars(fg, n.up = 5, n.down = 5)
